title: ARCS Verify signed-SRS CLI report
description: Descriptive schema for the --json output of the default signed-SRS subcommand. Non-normative: the verifier code is the source of truth. Fields are append-only in intent; consumers must tolerate additional properties.

chain_status.description: Reported separately from the eight Boolean results. For a standalone signed receipt the required value is not_applicable.

failure_codes.description: Stable codes enumerated in docs/FAILURE_CODES.md. Match exact strings.

details.description: Human-readable validator messages. Not stable strings; do not match on them.

passed.description: True only when all eight Boolean results are true and chain_status equals not_applicable.
